terbaru.judul: Two Flavon Froggatt-Nielsen Models with Genetic Algorithms
terbaru.pelajaran: We present the first systematic and comprehensive scan of two-flavon Froggatt-Nielsen (FN) models, employing artificial intelligence techniques to explore the high-dimensional, mixed discrete-continuous parameter space.

terbaru.judul: Code evolution for link prediction in complex networks
terbaru.pelajaran: The problem of predicting links in complex networks appears in different disciplines and has led to a variety of ingenious human-designed methods.

terbaru.judul: SAGE: Stochastic Prompt Optimization via Agent-Guided Exploration
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce SPO (Stochastic Prompt Optimization), a framework for stochastic search over prompt space, and compare three strategies of increasing sophistication: error-informed random search, a genetic algorithm with evolutionary operators, and SAGE (SPO via Agent-Guided Exploration), a multi-agent pipeline with diagnostic code execution
In this work, we present and evaluate constraint-aware variants of four evolutionary algorithms for auto-tuning.

terbaru.judul: Mutation and crossover of simplicial complexes
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we introduce matrix representations for colored graphs and their associated bubble graphs.

terbaru.judul: Modeling Doppler Shifts in Radial-Velocity Data with Deep Learning toward Earth-mass Exoplanet Detection
terbaru.pelajaran: The aim of this work is to develop a deep-learning framework that generalizes to real, unseen spectra and improves the detectability of Earth-mass planets in radial-velocity data.

terbaru.judul: Deep-Learning-Based Pixelated Microwave Filter Design and Characterization using Electro-Optical Electric-Field Measurements
terbaru.pelajaran: This study uses a deep learning approach combining convolutional neural networks with genetic algorithms to automate pixelated microwave filter synthesis.

terbaru.judul: Deep Learning-Driven Inverse Design of Doherty Power Amplifiers Using Pixelated Combiners and Dual-State Impedance Synthesis
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we propose a three-port Doherty combiner design methodology that combines deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs), pixelated layout representations, and genetic algorithms (GA) with dual-state impedance synthesis to address both peak and back-off power conditions.

terbaru.judul: StereoFactory: A Unified Merging Framework for Robust Stereo Matching
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose StereoFactory, a coarse-to-fine evolutionary framework for adaptive model merging.
